scope: Read-only root delivery input audit; no root files modified/staged/moved/deleted. Only this child evidence JSON is written.
status_mode: --short -z --untracked-files=all with LFS filters disabled for read-only status

policy.formal_history: Keep canonical revisions before-muted-refinement/before-muted-theme/baseline/before-information-expansion/muted-refinement with original prompts/references/model outputs/selection records, including rejected results. README.md line11 documents this purpose.
policy.formal_current: Keep current canonical figure.*, source.tex/source.render.json, data, generator/theme, labels/replay/text/fonts/provenance/review and component panels.
policy.exact_panel_exceptions: Keep SNN analytic curves/no-curves-background and composition inputs, HMC chart/topology, transformer-efficient-attention local-window-panel/data/source/renderer. These are not source export exclusions.
policy.origin_evidence: Three sample xattr inspections gave no iCloud conflict metadata. HMC has only com.apple.provenance. Numbered-copy cause is not established.
policy.move_boundary: Root must recheck recorded bytes before moving. Ignored build/ destination must remain task-local and recoverable; this review does not execute moves.

reference_search.numbered_names_result: no exact textual references in specified tex/json/md/py/sh/txt search scope
reference_search.source_export_names_result: no explicit source.pdf/png/svg textual references in tex/figures/specs/plans/scripts
reference_search.limitations: No claim that all possible dynamic path construction is absent; actual reproduce.py destination move provides the source-export lifecycle evidence.
